blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Снег пролежал всего ___ (час, acc. sg.).
exercises.prompt: The snow was there for just an hour.
exercises.why: **час → час** (acc. sg.). Masculine, inanimate, nominative singular in a consonant. Declines like DLI's дом — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. дом). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  Declension: sg. час · часа · часу · час · часом · часе; pl. часы · часов · часам · часы · часами · часах.  «The accusative of masculine animate nouns is the same as the genitive. The accusative of masculine inanimate nouns and of all neuter nouns is the same as the nominative.» — DLI, Lesson 32.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Он приехал во ___ (вторник, acc. sg.).
exercises.prompt: He arrived on Tuesday.
exercises.why: **вторник → вторник** (acc. sg.). Masculine, inanimate, nominative singular in a consonant. Declines like DLI's дом — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. дом). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  Declension: sg. вторник · вторника · вторнику · вторник · вторником · вторнике; pl. вторники · вторников · вторникам · вторники · вторниками · вторниках.  «The accusative of masculine animate nouns is the same as the genitive. The accusative of masculine inanimate nouns and of all neuter nouns is the same as the nominative.» — DLI, Lesson 32.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Хлеб наш насущный дай нам на ___ (сей день, acc. sg.).
exercises.prompt: Give us this day our daily bread.
exercises.why: **день → день** (acc. sg.). Masculine, inanimate, nominative singular in -ь. Declines like DLI's автомобиль — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. автомобиль). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  **сей → сей** (acc. sg. m., agreeing with день). «сей» is a pronoun-type word with its own declension, not the regular adjective pattern, so no ending rule is claimed. Its forms (m. sg.): сей · сего · сему · сей (inan.) / сего (anim.) · сим · сём.  Declension: sg. день · дня · дню · день · днём · дне; pl. дни · дней · дням · дни · днями · днях.  «The accusative of masculine animate nouns is the same as the genitive. The accusative of masculine inanimate nouns and of all neuter nouns is the same as the nominative.» — DLI, Lesson 32.  «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Они явились почти через ___ (месяц, acc. sg.) после тревожной ночи.
exercises.prompt: *Максим Горький, «Мать»*
exercises.why: **месяц → месяц** (acc. sg.). Masculine, inanimate, nominative singular in a consonant. Declines like DLI's дом — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. дом). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  Declension: sg. месяц · месяца · месяцу · месяц · месяцем · месяце; pl. месяцы · месяцев · месяцам · месяцы · месяцами · месяцах.  «The accusative of masculine animate nouns is the same as the genitive. The accusative of masculine inanimate nouns and of all neuter nouns is the same as the nominative.» — DLI, Lesson 32.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Простите за ___ (неприятная секунда, acc. pl.), причиненные вам во время путешествия.
exercises.prompt: *Александр Беляев, «Звезда КЭЦ»*
exercises.why: **секунда → секунды** (acc. pl.). Feminine, inanimate; nominative plural секунды. Declines like DLI's газета — every plural form has the same endings (A. pl. газеты). Ending -а → -ы.  **неприятный → неприятные** (acc. pl., agreeing with секунды). Adjective type I, hard — declines like DLI's новый (every form has the same endings): A. anim. = G., inan. = N. No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  Declension: sg. секунда · секунды · секунде · секунду · секундой · секунде; pl. секунды · секунд · секундам · секунды · секундами · секундах.  «The accusative plural of inanimate nouns is the same as the nominative plural. The accusative plural of animate nouns is the same as the genitive plural.» — DLI, Lesson 42.  «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  «Notice that the adjectives of the "soft", "guttural" and "sibilant" types are declined in the plural in the very same way.» — DLI, Lesson 48.  Adjectives in the accusative: animate = genitive, inanimate = nominative (masculine and plural); feminine -ую, -юю. — DLI, Lessons 46–47.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Эту статую воздвигли десять ___ (лёт, acc. sg.) назад.
exercises.prompt: This statue was erected ten years ago.
exercises.why: **лёт → лет** (acc. sg.). Masculine, inanimate, nominative singular in a consonant. Declines like DLI's дом — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. дом). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  Declension: sg. лёт · лёта · лёту · лёт · лётом · лёте; pl. лёты · лётов · лётам · лёты · лётами · лётах.  «The accusative of masculine animate nouns is the same as the genitive. The accusative of masculine inanimate nouns and of all neuter nouns is the same as the nominative.» — DLI, Lesson 32.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Что ты делал в ___ (праздник, acc. pl.)?
exercises.prompt: What did you do during the holidays?
exercises.why: **праздник → праздники** (acc. pl.). Masculine, inanimate; nominative plural праздники. Declines like DLI's стол — every plural form has the same endings (A. pl. столы). Ending — (no ending) → -и.  Declension: sg. праздник · праздника · празднику · праздник · праздником · празднике; pl. праздники · праздников · праздникам · праздники · праздниками · праздниках.  «The accusative plural of inanimate nouns is the same as the nominative plural. The accusative plural of animate nouns is the same as the genitive plural.» — DLI, Lesson 42.  «The letter ы never follows г, к, х, ж, ч, ш, щ; therefore: книга — книги, река — реки, госпожа — госпожи.» — DLI, Lesson 23.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Не волнуйтесь, на ___ (сегодняшний день, acc. sg.) косметическая хирургия гораздо лучше, чем во времена доктора Франкенштейна.

No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  **сегодняшний → сегодняшний** (acc. sg. m., agreeing with день). Declension: sg. день · дня · дню · день · днём · дне; pl. дни · дней · дням · дни · днями · днях.  «The accusative of masculine animate nouns is the same as the genitive. The accusative of masculine inanimate nouns and of all neuter nouns is the same as the nominative.» — DLI, Lesson 32.  «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 47. exercises.q: Но через ___ (сутки, acc. pl.) друзья-противники опять сплывались и новый разговор затевали.
exercises.prompt: *Михаил Салтыков-Щедрин, «Карась-идеалист»*
exercises.why: **сутки → сутки** (acc. pl.). A plural-only noun (it has no singular); nominative plural сутки. No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  Declension (plural only): сутки · суток · суткам · сутки · сутками · сутках.  «The accusative plural of inanimate nouns is the same as the nominative plural. The accusative plural of animate nouns is the same as the genitive plural.» — DLI, Lesson 42.  «The letter ы never follows г, к, х, ж, ч, ш, щ; therefore: книга — книги, река — реки, госпожа — госпожи.» — DLI, Lesson 23.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Однако я весьма вам благодарна за ___ (сегодняшнее утро, acc. sg.).
exercises.prompt: *Иван Тургенев, «Рудин»*
exercises.why: **утро → утро** (acc. sg.). Neuter, nominative singular in -о. Declines like DLI's окно — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. окно). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  **сегодняшний → сегодняшнее** (acc. sg. n., agreeing with утро). Adjective type II, soft — declines like DLI's синий (every form has the same endings): A. синее. No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  Declension: sg. утро · утра · утру · утро · утром · утре; pl. утра · утр · утрам · утра · утрами · утрах.  «The accusative of masculine animate nouns is the same as the genitive. The accusative of masculine inanimate nouns and of all neuter nouns is the same as the nominative.» — DLI, Lesson 32.  «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 47. exercises.q: ___ (неделя, acc. sg.) назад мне выдернули зуб.
exercises.prompt: I had a tooth pulled a week ago.
exercises.why: **неделя → неделю** (acc. sg.). Feminine, nominative singular in -я. Declines like DLI's неделя — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. неделю). Ending -я → -ю.  Declension: sg. неделя · недели · неделе · неделю · неделей · неделе; pl. недели · недель · неделям · недели · неделями · неделях.  «The accusative singular of all feminine nouns ending in -ь is the same as nominative. The accusative singular of all other feminine nouns ends in -у or -ю.» — DLI, Lesson 33.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: ___ (каждая весна, acc. sg.) река здесь разливается.
exercises.prompt: Every spring the river floods here.
exercises.why: **весна → весну** (acc. sg.). Feminine, nominative singular in -а. Declines like DLI's газета — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. газету). Ending -а → -у.  **каждый → каждую** (acc. sg. f., agreeing with весну). Adjective type I, hard — declines like DLI's новый (every form has the same endings): A. новую. Ending -ая → -ую.  Declension: sg. весна · весны · весне · весну · весной · весне; pl. вёсны · вёсен · вёснам · вёсны · вёснами · вёснах.  «The accusative singular of all feminine nouns ending in -ь is the same as nominative. The accusative singular of all other feminine nouns ends in -у or -ю.» — DLI, Lesson 33.  «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 47. exercises.q: Через ___ (минута, acc. pl.) две загремели ключи, и кто-то, казалось, сходил по лестнице.
exercises.prompt: *Николай Гоголь, «Тарас Бульба»*
exercises.why: **минута → минуты** (acc. pl.). Feminine, inanimate; nominative plural минуты. Declines like DLI's газета — every plural form has the same endings (A. pl. газеты). Ending -а → -ы. The accusative plural of animate nouns is the same as the genitive plural.» — DLI, Lesson 42.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Слышало, слышало вещее мое все эти речи еще за ___ (месяц, acc. sg.)!
exercises.prompt: *Николай Гоголь, «Вечера на хуторе близ Диканьки»*
exercises.why: **месяц → месяц** (acc. sg.). Masculine, inanimate, nominative singular in a consonant. Declines like DLI's дом — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. дом). exercises.q: Два-три ___ (день, gen. sg.) назад Пномпень затопило.
exercises.prompt: Phnom Penh was flooded two or three days ago.
exercises.why: **день → дня** (gen. sg.). Masculine, inanimate, nominative singular in -ь. Declines like DLI's автомобиль — every singular form has the same endings (G. sg. автомобиля). Ending -ь → -я, with the fleeting -е- of the stem dropped: дн- + -я.  Declension: sg. день · дня · дню · день · днём · дне; pl. дни · дней · дням · дни · днями · днях.  Genitive endings: masculine -а, -я (книга студента, книга учителя); neuter -а, -я (стакан вина, часть здания); feminine -ы, -и (стакан воды, часть семьи, часть тетради). — DLI, Lesson 23.  «Certain masculine nouns have the vowels е or о only in the nominative singular (and in the accusative if inanimate): отец — отца, американец — американца, кусок — куска, звонок — звонка.» — DLI, Lesson 32.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).
